_policy: Inputs describe the teams (performance, roster, availability, travel), never what the public or betting markets expect. Market lines and public pick shares are excluded as features.
_about: Every data source the pipeline knows about. 'access' says how data gets in; 'timing' says whether its numbers are frozen before the tournament (safe as features) or include tournament results (leak). build/ingest reads this file; test/registry.test.js checks it.

sources.name: Barttorvik season game files
sources.how: build/build-data.js downloads raw/skedYYYY.json; ratings are recomputed here from box scores
sources.notes: Date-filtered rating pages sit behind a browser check; we do not bypass it. Box scores let us compute any cutoff ourselves.

sources.name: Wikipedia tournament pages
sources.how: raw/wiki/YYYY.txt via action=raw
sources.notes: Seeds and regions are pre-tournament facts; scores are labels only.

sources.name: Kaggle: March Madness Data (Nishaan Amin)
sources.how: build/ingest/kaggle.js reads raw/kaggle/csv/*.csv (archive from the Kaggle API)
sources.notes: Aggregates KenPom, Barttorvik, Heat Check, 538, ESPN, AP poll, Yahoo, EvanMiya, TeamRankings, adambrackets, basketunderreview. Per-file timing is in build/ingest/kaggle-files.js.

sources.name: KenPom
sources.how: Kaggle 'KenPom Barttorvik.csv' (KADJ EM/O/D/T) and 'KenPom Preseason.csv'
sources.notes: Subscription site; not scraped. Win totals in the Kaggle file match pre-tournament records exactly (docs/kaggle-profile.md).

sources.name: Heat Check CBB
sources.how: Kaggle 'Heat Check Ratings.csv', 'Heat Check Tournament Index.csv'
sources.notes: Ratings include INJURY RANK and ROSTER RANK, the only injury-aware columns available. Tournament Index WINS is unverified and quarantined until test/leakage.test.js clears it.

sources.name: 538 power ratings
sources.how: Kaggle '538 Ratings.csv'; original forecasts also on github.com/fivethirtyeight/data
sources.notes: Discontinued after 2024.

sources.name: ESPN
sources.how: build/news/espn.js: public site.api.espn.com scoreboard + game summary (recap article, box score)
sources.notes: Recaps are written after the game: analysis only, never features. Betting odds are deliberately not collected: market and public opinion are not used as inputs. Public Picks (who-picked-whom, 2026 only, via Kaggle) label unpopular results; they are never features.

sources.name: AP poll (College Poll Archive)
sources.how: Kaggle 'AP Poll Data.csv' (every week since 2008)
sources.notes: Only weeks before Selection Sunday may be used. Preseason rank is a known tournament predictor.

sources.name: EvanMiya
sources.how: Kaggle 'EvanMiya.csv'
sources.notes: Includes KILLSHOTS (10-0 runs) and injury rank.

sources.name: TeamRankings
sources.how: Kaggle 'TeamRankings*.csv' (overall, home, away, neutral splits)
sources.notes: Ratings plus luck and consistency ratings.

sources.name: Yahoo Sports
sources.how: Folded into Kaggle files (bracket pick data)
sources.notes: No direct ingestion.

sources.name: Adam Brackets
sources.how: Kaggle 'Z Rating Teams.csv' and resume data
sources.notes: 'Z Rating Cumulative.csv' is an all-time aggregate: quarantined.

sources.name: Basket Under Review
sources.how: Kaggle 'RPPF *.csv'
sources.notes: RPPF ratings, preseason ratings, conference ratings.

sources.name: News coverage around games
sources.how: build/news/espn.js stores recaps and game news; build/news/extract.js turns text into structured factors with Claude
sources.coverage: Historical recaps via ESPN; live pregame news for the current season
sources.notes: Each item is tagged pregame or postgame by publish time vs tip-off. Only pregame items may become features; postgame items feed the miss review.

sources.name: ESPN player box scores (sportsdataverse data releases)
sources.how: build/ingest/players.mjs downloads raw/players/player_box_YYYY.parquet (hash-pinned) and reads it with hyparquet
sources.license: sportsdataverse (MIT-licensed tooling; data from ESPN public endpoints)
sources.notes: Only games before each team's first NCAA game are used. Gives roster shape, continuity, transfers, experience, and a box-score injury signal (did the top players play their usual minutes in the last 3 games).

sources.name: Margin-of-victory Elo (computed here)
sources.how: build/ingest/elo.js from raw/skedYYYY.json
sources.notes: K and season carry-over tuned on regular-season games only; snapshot before each team's first NCAA game.

sources.name: Schedule workload, rest and road share (computed here)
sources.how: build/ingest/schedule.js from raw/skedYYYY.json
sources.notes: Games in the last 7/14 days, days of rest before the first NCAA game, share of games on the road. Days of rest before each tournament game are computed per game.

sources.name: Sports-Reference season coach pages
sources.how: build/ingest/coaches.js; one page per season, 4 seconds apart, cached and hash-pinned
sources.notes: Career columns include the season itself (tournament too), so for season Y they are read from the coach's row on an earlier season's page. Only identity and start year come from season Y.

sources.name: Open-Meteo elevation and historical weather
sources.how: build/ingest/gamesite.js: elevation for every campus and game site; hourly surface pressure at each site for tip-off
sources.notes: Weather is a fact about the venue, not the teams; it can only matter through altitude for indoor games.

sources.name: ESPN scoreboards: tip-off time, venue, attendance, home/away
sources.how: build/ingest/gamesite.js (cached under raw/espn/scoreboard)
sources.notes: Tip time, venue and home designation are known beforehand. Attendance is counted at the game and is only a proxy for which crowd will show up.

sources.name: Kaggle March Machine Learning Mania (competition data)
sources.how: You download the competition files with your own free Kaggle account (accept the rules, Download All) into raw/mmlm/; build/ingest/mmlm.js reads MMasseyOrdinals.csv and MTeamSpellings.csv
sources.coverage: Results since 1985 (box scores since 2003); Massey ordinals since 2003
sources.notes: Only rankings published on or before day 133 (Selection Sunday) are used. Human polls (AP, USA) are kept as a separate opinion column. Not yet used: results before 2008, which would need our ratings rebuilt from these box scores.

_security: Downloads go through build/lib/safe-fetch.js (HTTPS, host allowlist, size caps) and every raw file is SHA-256 pinned in sources/lock.json. Downloaded files are data only: nothing executes them. News text is sanitized and screened for prompt injection (build/news/sanitize.js) before a model reads it, and extracted claims must quote the source.
